title: 2004 AMC 12B Problem 9
statement: The point \((-3, 2)\) is rotated \(90^\circ\) clockwise around the origin to point \(B.\) Point \(B\) is then reflected in the line \(y = x\) to point \(C.\) What are the coordinates of \(C?\)

solutions.text:
Rotating \((-3, 2)\) by \(90^\circ\) clockwise sends \((x, y) \to (y, -x),\) giving \(B = (2, 3).\) Reflecting in \(y = x\) swaps coordinates, giving \(C = (3, 2).\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: A \(90^\circ\) clockwise rotation sends \((x, y)\) to \((y, -x)\)
Reflecting in \(y = x\) swaps the coordinates
